subject: Your 3AM self from 53 days ago
preview_text: The difference between who you were and who you are now is embarrassing — in the best way.
body_paragraphs: Remember that night 53 days ago? The one where you couldn't sleep, your chest felt hollow, and you swore you'd never feel normal again. You probably don't want to — but think about it for a second. That version of you was drowning in the same thoughts, the same what-ifs, the same urge to text them at 3AM. Now look at you.

Here's the embarrassing truth: before this app, you were stuck in a loop. Replaying memories, avoiding your phone, waking up with that knot in your stomach. After using it — even just opening it on the hard days — you started noticing shifts. That urge to check their socials got quieter. That 3AM spiral got shorter. You built a version of yourself that doesn't need permission to move forward.

The feature that made the biggest difference? The mood tracker. It sounds simple, but seeing your own progress — the ups, the downs, the plateaus — turns abstract healing into something real. You can literally see the before and after. And if you haven't checked it in a while, there's a 40% chance you're doing better than you think.
Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy now and check your mood history. See the person you were 53 days ago compared to today. P.S. — That 3AM version of you would be proud of who you've become.
